item.title: Vehicle Crashes Into Fence Near State Supported Living Center
item.description: CARLSBAD, TX — A sedan crashed into a chain-link fence near the state-supported living center in Carlsbad on Tuesday afternoon, after being struck by another vehicle. The wreck occurred around 1 p.m. Medics initially requested the availability of Shannon Medical Center's AirMed1 helicopter but were later told to stand down after determining the situation was less severe than initially believed. Learn More Here.

item.title: U.S. CBP Seizes Nearly 7 Pounds of Ketamine Hidden in Ethernet Cable Spool
item.description: LOUISVILLE, KY — U.S. Customs and Border Protection officers in Louisville intercepted nearly seven pounds of ketamine concealed inside a spool of ethernet cable that was bound for Belgium, authorities said.The shipment, declared as “ethernet cable,” was flagged in late January when a CBP canine team conducted a routine sweep of the inspection area. A detection dog named Gandalf alerted officers to the package, prompting a secondary inspection. Learn More Here.

item.title: No. 20 Menard Girls Hold Off Eden to Win District Title
item.description: EDEN, TX — The Menard Lady Jackets are the No. 20-ranked girls basketball team in the state in Class 1A, and it’s easy to see why with the way they play defense.Menard managed only 34 points Tuesday against district rival Eden, but the Lady Jackets’ defense made sure that was more than enough in a 34-26 win that locked up the District 12-1A title.
